data.exact_reserve_text: During 2019, gross ultimate claims in respect of prior underwriting years (2017 and prior) increased by $64.2m ($29.5m net of RI). Of this, $58.3m ($26.9m net of RI) relates to Casualty division losses on 2016 and prior underwriting years of account. The remainder is driven by newly occurring large losses, mostly from multi-year construction policies in the Tech division. At the same time claim experience during 2019 on the Aviation and Marine divisions on 2017 and prior underwriting years has been within expectations.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1919 experienced material adverse prior-year development in 2019: gross ultimate claims for prior underwriting years (2017 and earlier) increased by $64.2m (c.9.1% of opening gross claims outstanding). The deterioration was driven predominantly by Casualty division losses relating to 2016 and earlier (c.$58.3m) with the balance driven by newly occurring large construction-related losses in the Technical/Property area. Aviation and Marine prior-year experience was reported as being within expectations.

data.data_quality_notes: Amounts extracted from scanned images of the 2019 annual report. Opening gross claims outstanding (brought forward) taken from the 'Reconciliation of provision for claims' table (page 33) and is presented in USD thousands in the report; converted here to millions. Prior-year development taken from explicit narrative on page 37 (gross $64.2m). A gross claims development triangle is present in the report (pages ~40-41) but the scan resolution prevented reliable numeric extraction of every cell; triangle metadata (existence/page/units) is provided but individual development row values are not fully parsed here. All amounts remain in the report's functional currency (USD).

_claims_triangle.note: Gross claims development triangle exists in the report on page 40 but numeric extraction of per-cell development rows was not possible from the scanned images with high confidence. Use the narrative & reconciliation table for prior-year development figures.
